Al-Mu'Aadh bin Jabal was known for his eloquence, bravery, and commitment to Islam. He was given the mission to spread Islam in Yemen and miraculously saved the people from an imminent disaster with his counsel and wisdom.

Additionally, it can be seen as a reminder of the crucial role that companions and mentors play in spiritual development, as represented by the historical figure of Mu'Aadh ibn Jabal who helped guide the people of Yemen towards Islam.
